“So we give you the robots, and you strand us here?  Sounds like a great deal.”

The Pirate known as La Capitan raised her sword at Legacy,

“It is better than the alternative.”  She gave them a wicked smile, and the crew behind her on the deck laughed.

Legacy smiled back, looking unconcerned.

“Let me make a counter proposal, you all surrender now and we’ll let the Temporal Continuity Initiative try their first Temporal Criminals.”

“You try my patience chiquita, I’ve followed these two long enough, now you run home to Daddy while you still have your legs.”

Pauline’s fists clenched, this lady was getting to her, trying to make her mad.  Anthony had a feeling that wasn’t the best strategy. . .
